basic_info.description: This beautifully updated middle flat offers a bright and airy living space, ideally located just moments from the vibrant heart of the Castro. Experience the best of city living with immediate access to all that the neighborhood has to offer. The residence showcases classic period charm complemented by modern upgrades in the kitchen and bathroom. The renovated kitchen, featuring quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast nook, opens to a spacious formal dining areaperfect for entertaining family and friends. The three generously sized bedrooms provide versatile options for sleeping, gaming, or working from home. The living room offers an inviting space to relax and unwind. Additional features include in-unit laundry hookups and substantial storage in the lower level. Please note that the staged photos are for marketing purposes only and depict unit 672; no intent to misrepresent the current unit is implied. Buyers to investigate to their own satisfaction.
